open_questions: Station lanes: split_targets only lists lanes with a planet destination (b >= 0), so a Space Storage lane is not offered for a split. Should it be?
With three or more lanes the bar uses the existing split pair, else the first two lanes. No pair picker was built (not in the brief). OK?
Layout is stacked (names row, [-] slider [+] row, Stop/Done row) to fit the panel width, not the single line in the proposal. OK?
handoff: Option A built. Storage row with 2+ lanes shows one Split toggle; it opens a bar at 50/50 (sets the engine at once). Slider 10-90 plus [-]/[+] in 10-point steps; Done keeps the split, Stop split clears it (engine.clear_split). Route rows of split lanes show a 'Split N%' tag in lane colour (orange first, green second); hovering a tag brightens the bar. Engine rule: lane_split returns {} and clears stale shares when the partner lane has no ship, so _split_limit gives the surviving lane all stock. Removed begin_split, _on_split_click, the 'split' pending key and the old buttons. Station pick untouched. Tests: 635 pass, 0 fail. Not checked by eye: bar layout and width, tag colours, hover brightening, slider drag feel. No git run.
